_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/combat/test_dealt_combat_damage_by_subtype.py. t_dcs_estinien is Estinien Varlineau's second-main-phase line on a bare 3/3 Human Knight; t_dcs_dragon is a vanilla 2/2 Dragon.

cards.name: Test Estinien
cards.oracle_text: At the beginning of your second main phase, you draw X cards and lose X life, where X is the number of your opponents who were dealt combat damage by Test Estinien or a Dragon this turn.
